metadata.title: Sridhant Dalai | Vibe Coder
metadata.description: Sridhant Dalai is a full stack developer with a passion for building web applications and APIs. He is a self-taught developer with a strong foundation in frontend and backend technologies.
metadata.keywords: Sridhant Dalai, Vibe Coder, full stack developer portfolio, web developer portfolio, web developer in Bangladesh, web developer in Dhaka

hero.title: Vibe Coder
hero.bio: Coding, traveling, and creating innovative digital experiences while continuously learning, exploring, and growing every day.

about.text:
I'm Sridhant Dalai, originally from Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, and currently living in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. I love traveling, exploring new places, and learning about different cultures.

I'm passionate about Data Science and Full-Stack Web Development, enjoying the process of building modern web applications and solving real-world problems through technology.

projects.title: Tatva 2026
projects.description: Official website for Tatva 2026, the annual techno-cultural festival of NIT Patna. Designed and developed a modern, responsive platform featuring event showcases, schedules, registration workflows, and festival information for participants and visitors.

projects.title: GadiWala
projects.description: A smart fare-sharing platform that helps users discover and calculate shared taxi and auto-rickshaw prices. Built to make local transportation more transparent, affordable, and convenient for daily commuters.

projects.title: NGL Clone
projects.description: An anonymous messaging platform inspired by NGL. Users can generate unique links, receive anonymous messages, and engage with friends through a clean and secure user experience.

projects.title: Flash Vault
projects.description: A cloud storage application inspired by Google Drive. Features secure file uploads, file organization, storage management, and seamless access across devices through an intuitive interface.

projects.title: Expresso Official Website
projects.description: Official website for Expresso, the Art & Literary Club of NIT Patna. Developed a visually engaging platform to showcase events, publications, club activities, and member achievements while strengthening the club's digital presence.

projects.title: Replate
projects.description: A food sharing platform that connects individuals with excess food to those in need. Users can post available food items, browse listings, and coordinate pickups to reduce food waste and support local communities.

process.description: From idea to deployment, I follow a structured approach: planning, designing, developing, and optimizing. Every project is built with attention to performance, usability, and clean code to deliver a seamless user experience.

steps.title: Discovery & Planning
steps.description: I begin by understanding project goals, target users, and business requirements. Through research and strategic planning, I create a clear roadmap that ensures efficient development and successful project execution.

steps.title: Design & Architecture
steps.description: With a strong foundation in place, I design intuitive user experiences and scalable system architectures. Every design decision focuses on usability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

steps.title: Development & Implementation
steps.description: Using modern technologies and best coding practices, I transform concepts into fully functional applications. Clean, optimized, and maintainable code is at the core of every solution I build.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.description: I thoroughly test every feature to ensure reliability, responsiveness, and cross-device compatibility. This process helps identify issues early and guarantees a polished user experience.

steps.title: Deployment & Integration
steps.description: After rigorous testing, I deploy the application and integrate required services, APIs, and tools. I focus on delivering a smooth launch while ensuring stability, security, and ongoing performance.

contact.title: Let's Talk
contact.description: Have a project in mind or want to discuss potential opportunities? Drop me a message and I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
